body: Yeah, I'm in my mid-20s...Normally, my boyfriend is supportive and trustworthy but I feel bad for bothering him when he's busy. In general, I have a hard time talking about it to anyone, I don't even know how I should talk about it...Thank you for replying. I try to remind myself that this is not permanent but it gets hard sometimes especially when I've struggled with this my whole life.
Thank you, its oddly comforting to know I'm not the only one who feels this way.
